items.title: Winard Harper interviewed by Monk Rowe, Utica, New York, October 10, 2014
items.q: Jay Leonhart and I have been on some gigs together.

ctx.x: And you’ve worked with most of these guys before.

Yeah. In different situations. Dick Hyman and I, we’ve worked together over the years. Jay Leonhart and I have been on some gigs together. The last time I worked with him we might have done Dizzy’s with George Wein.
